'''Captain Harlan''' is a combat tutor and the head of the [[Lumbridge]] Guard found on a small hill outside of [[Lumbridge Castle]]. Players can acquire basic weapons from him for all 3 combat styles during and after the quest [[Mudfoot's Big Adventure]]. If a player has achieved [[Skill mastery|level 99]] in [[Defence]], they can purchase a [[Defence cape]] and its respective [[Defence hood|hood]] from him for {{NoCoins|99000}} coins.

Prior to an update, he was the '''melee combat tutor''' and would only explain melee combat. He also would hand out [[training shortsword]]s and [[training shield]]s.

==Treasure Trails==
{{Cipher|Captain Harlan|medium|[[Clue scroll (medium) - BZOSZHM GZQKZM|BZOSZHM GZQKZM]]}}. He will present the player a [[challenge scroll]] asking, "''How many [[snakeskin]]s are needed in order to [[Crafting|craft]] 44 [[Snakeskin boots|boots]], 29 [[Snakeskin vambraces|vambraces]] and 34 [[Snakeskin bandana|bandanas]]?''", the answer to which is 666.

==Stock==
If a player has at least one other 99, they will receive the [[Defence cape#Trimmed|trimmed variant]] of the cape instead.
